purpose: Define a deterministic, no-lookahead observation protocol joining finalized underlying alerts to eligible naked-option K-line units without computing results or inventing a Feitian rule.

timestamp_semantics.underlying_source_labels: timezone-naive local period-end labels normalized to UTC before comparison
timestamp_semantics.decision_cutoff_rule: Every alert field and every eligibility field must be computed only from timestamps less than or equal to that trading date's decision timestamp.
timestamp_semantics.confirmation_clock_rule: No post-decision confirmation window is authorized until an authentic, hash-pinned bare-K or DD-line rule defines its start, end, cadence and bar-completion semantics.

alert_and_side_rules.alert_requirement: The underlying input must explicitly carry a PA alert identity and direction. Descriptive bar direction, breakout, EMA alignment or any combination of them may not be converted into an alert.
alert_and_side_rules.side_mapping_role: This mapping filters observation to the alert-consistent option side; it never ranks or chooses a contract.
alert_and_side_rules.multiple_alerts_same_key: Preserve each distinct hash-pinned alert identity. Exact duplicate identities are invalid; conflicting directions each become abstain_conflicting_alert_direction.

observation_order.population_rule: Observe every eligible unit matching the joined product/date and mapped option side; do not choose a strike or month.
observation_order.tie_rule: Two units equal on the full premium_unit_key are an identity collision and invalidate that joined observation; source row order is timestamp ascending and duplicate timestamps invalidate the unit.
observation_order.cross_cadence_rule: Cadences remain distinct observations. Min15 is not substituted for missing min5 and min5 is not resampled to manufacture min15 eligibility.
observation_order.price_rule: Use only authentic OHLC fields from the bound eligible unit. No modeled, synthetic, interpolated or forward-filled price is permitted.

transition_order: Validate the exact input hashes, schemas and retrospective_finalized labels; otherwise invalid_identity_or_timestamp.
Require an explicit PA alert identity and direction; otherwise blocked_missing_explicit_pa_alert.
Apply the frozen direction-side mapping; a non-directional value becomes abstain_direction and conflicting alerts become abstain_conflicting_alert_direction.
Require a hash-pinned per-unit eligibility membership record; aggregate counts alone become blocked_missing_unit_membership.
If no eligible unit matches the joined key and mapped side, emit abstain_no_eligible_unit.
Validate unit identity, unique ordered timestamps and strict cutoff; failures become invalid_identity_or_timestamp.
Require every bar named by the authentic rule; an absent bar becomes abstain_missing_required_bar with no fill or cadence substitution.
If no authentic rule package satisfies rule_recovery_gate, emit blocked_authentic_rule_unrecovered.
An explicit PA alert with valid eligible observations remains alert_only unless every frozen authentic confirmation predicate is satisfied.
confirmed_bare_k is reachable only by literal application of a rule package accepted by rule_recovery_gate; protocol implementations may not infer an equivalent rule.

accepted_source_types: committed research note with exact algorithm
rule_recovery_gate.authenticity_requirement: The source must explicitly identify the rule as Feitian bare-K or DD-line. Similar candle, swing, percent-distance or generic support rules are not equivalent.
rule_recovery_gate.ambiguity_rule: Missing parameters, discretionary chart interpretation, contradictory definitions or an unavailable primary definition preserve the blocked state.
rule_recovery_gate.contract_immutability: Research discovered after this freeze may document whether the gate is satisfied, but may not silently amend this protocol. A usable recovered rule requires a separately reviewed, versioned successor contract committed before observing premium paths.

missing_data_rules.post_cutoff_only_bar: Treat as missing; never admit the row.

rejection_tests: Reject a changed byte in either bound input.
Reject any underlying field or premium row timestamped after the decision cutoff.
Prove that appending a post-cutoff row cannot change any pre-cutoff state.
Reject conversion of descriptive underlying diagnostics into a PA alert.
Reject aggregate eligibility evidence as proof of a specific unit's membership.
Reject duplicate unit identities or duplicate premium timestamps.
Reject missing-bar fill, interpolation, resampling or cadence substitution.
Reject strike or month ranking and any one-contract tie winner.
Reject confirmed_bare_k when the authentic rule gate is blocked.
Reject any output outside the protocol-evidence allowlist.

promotion.next_gate: Publish protocol-only evidence. Then separately supply hash-pinned explicit PA alerts, per-unit eligible membership and an authentic machine-testable bare-K or DD-line definition; freeze a successor contract before reading any premium path.
